caption: The drawing depicts two rectangular cloth objects, one overlaid on top of the other, rendered in pencil on a yellowed, aged paper background. Both rectangles have scalloped edges, with the lower, larger rectangle prominently featuring a detailed, repeated lacy floral pattern along its border. The upper rectangle is smaller and positioned to cover the upper portion of the lower rectangle, partially obscuring it, and is filled with evenly-spaced diagonal cross-hatching. Both objects vary in shading, with hatching and subtle coloring done in a light brownish hue to differentiate segments. The background is blank, and the entirety of the drawing is centered vertically and horizontally on the page.
title: Small Cravat
